name: HS2 MIDI Player
description: Plays MIDI files and USB MIDI on all 16 parts of the Hypersonic 2 engine, with General MIDI program changes. Needs your own Hypersonic 2 content folder.
author: HS2 Port

assets.label: Hypersonic 2 Content
assets.description: Only needed when the Hypersonic 2 sound generator is not installed with its content: this tool uses that module's content folder.
assets.hint: Copy the contents of your 'Hypersonic 2 Content' folder here, so that content/Patches and content/Samples exist. Nothing from Steinberg ships with this module.
